title: a2a-check --json output
description: One report per target, in the order given. Finding codes are stable identifiers; new codes may be added in a minor release, so a consumer should treat an unknown code by its level.

card_url.description: the Agent Card URL that was fetched

verdict.description: fail if any finding fails, else warn if any warns, else pass

agent.description: the card's name, or null when no card was read

level.description: fail: a v1.0 client cannot use the card; warn: usable but something will trip a client; info: true and not a fault
